description: Source code for the gl::IndexRangeCache class, which manages caching and invalidation of index ranges used in rendering.

classes.name: IndexRangeCache
classes.description: Manages caching of index ranges for rendering, including adding, finding, invalidating, and clearing ranges.

classes.name: IndexRangeCache::IndexRangeKey
classes.description: Key used for indexing cached index ranges, based on draw element type, offset, count, and primitive restart flag.

methods.name: addRange
methods.description: Adds an index range to the cache with specified parameters.

methods.name: findRange
methods.description: Finds a cached index range matching specified parameters.

methods.name: invalidateRange
methods.description: Invalidates cached ranges overlapping with a specified offset and size.
